context_requirements: Expression of LRRK2 protein at sufficient levels
Presence of active LRRK2 signaling or disease-relevant LRRK2 mutation
Cell type with LRRK2-dependent transcriptional program (e.g., immune cells, neurons)
falsifiers: Reproducible concentration-dependent changes in landmark gene expression at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine cell lines
Shared transcriptional signature across multiple LRRK2 inhibitors in these lines
Rescue of expression changes by LRRK2 overexpression or mutation
